title: finding(app-shell): `ActionPreview`'s `INHERITED_TARGET` docblock cites the resolver as reading `field.reference_to` — a key `@objectstack/spec` refuses by name, so an author who follows it writes metadata the platform rejects

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (Seat: domain:ui#2, session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) while accepting PR objectui#10158 for objectui#10129. ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's production.

⚠️ Cited by content rather than by line address, per AGENTS.md #11 — a cross-file `path:line` is banned outright, and this card would otherwise rot the first time a line moves above the thing it names.

## The finding

The docblock above `INHERITED_TARGET` in `packages/app-shell`'s `ActionPreview` metadata-admin preview tells its reader what the runtime resolver does:

> `The real one arrives from the bound field at runtime`
> ``(`resolveActionParams`: `referenceTo: param.reference ?? field.reference_to`).``

**The resolver does not do that.** Its only `param.reference ??` site in the whole package reads:

```
referenceTo: param.reference ?? field.reference,
```

⇒ the citation names `field.reference_to` where the code reads `field.reference`. objectui#6837 narrowed that read, and the comment was not narrowed with it.

## Why this is more than a stale comment

⭐ `reference_to` is not merely the old spelling — it is a spelling `@objectstack/spec` **refuses by name**. From `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`:

> `always REFUSED `reference_to` by name (`unrecognized_keys`, carrying the rename: "Did you mean `reference_to` → `reference`?")`

and `packages/spec/src/conversions/conversions.test.ts` pins it as 「the canonical field schema declares `reference` and rejects `reference_to` with the rename」.

⇒ the docblock points its reader at a field-def key **that reader cannot publish**. An author (human or agent) who takes the comment at face value writes `reference_to` into a field definition and the platform rejects it by name. That is the shape of a metadata trap, not a documentation nit.

## Measured by this seat, ⛔ not relayed

Both halves were re-derived here before filing, each with a lit control:

- The divergence: a tree-wide `git grep "param.reference ??"` over `packages/app-shell` on `origin/main` returns exactly **two** rows — the resolver's real one reading `field.reference`, and the `ActionPreview` docblock's quotation reading `field.reference_to`. ⛔ There is no third site and no branch where the comment is true.
- The refusal: `reference_to` appears in **8** files under `packages/spec/src` on objectstack's `origin/main` (that count is the control — the instrument finds the term), and among those rows are the refusal text and its pin quoted above.

## The fix

One line: make the citation quote what the resolver reads. ⚠️ And cite it by content, not by a path or a line — AGENTS.md #11 is why this recurred at all.

## ⚠️ Two further observations from the same pass, ⛔ neither filed, both recorded so a successor is named

1. `RecordDetailView` builds a **second, near-identical param-collection handler** that does not go through the object-store union PR objectui#10158 adds. ⛔ Not a defect today — that view receives the full objects list as a prop, which is why it was never in the reported path — but the two handlers are documented as a pair that must not drift, with a parity pin (`RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431`) existing for exactly that, and they now differ by the union. Successor: whoever next edits either handler; the parity pin names both and PR objectui#10158's Acceptance notes record the divergence.
2. `RuntimeField` in the action-param resolver still declares `reference_to`, which no read in that file has consumed since objectui#6837. Dead declaration, no behavioural effect (the ingestion door canonicalises both spellings). Successor: none — recorded so the next reader knows the member is inert rather than a live fallback.

## Dedupe words

`ActionPreview INHERITED_TARGET reference_to` · `resolveActionParams citation reference_to` · `field.reference_to stale docblock` · `objectui#6837 narrowed reference read` · `reference_to unrecognized_keys rename`
